column1: # Thresholds for the primer-quality warnings in
# crates/core/src/primer_quality.rs. Each is a published guideline, not a
# biological rule: breaking one produces a warning on a design that is still
# emitted (owner, 2026-10-14). See README.md for the source text of each and
# for the one disagreement between sources.
# constants still equal this file, so the fixture is the authority (D018).
# `name` matches the Rust constant. `value` is an integer or a percentage.

column3: a primer whose G+C is below this is warned about
a primer whose G+C is above this is warned about
the longest acceptable run of one base; 4 or more is warned about
the most acceptable repeats of a two-base unit; 5 or more is warned about
the longest acceptable run of G/C ending the primer; 3 or more is warned about
a primer shorter than this is warned about
a primer longer than this is warned about
a primer longer than this is past the practical limit for ordering a standard oligo
